'''Torina Discount Electronics, Inc.''' was a localized company based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Torina]] which had offices located in the [[Elrood Bazaar]]. A competitor with the larger [[Quality Electronics of Torina]], they made up for their smaller size by creating products of a significantly higher quality. Torina's prime focus was home consumer goods such as [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojectors]], entertainment centers, simple home [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and kitchen appliances.
